learning_outcomes.text: Ability to design a complex system, the process, the device, or the product under realistic constraints and conditions in such a way as to meet specific requirements; the ability to apply modern design methods for this purpose.

Ability to choose and use required modern techniques and tools for the analysis and solution of complex problems encountered in engineering practices; The ability to use informatics technologies effectively.
Ability to design and conduct experiments, collect data, analyze, interpret and discuss results for the study of complex engineering problems or discipline-specific research topics.
Ability to work efficiently in multi-disciplinary teams.
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in written; knowledge of at least one foreign language; writing reports effectively and understanding of written reports.
Awareness of the necessity of lifelong learning; the ability to access information, monitor developments in science and technology, and renew him/herself constantly.
Knowledge about the effects of engineering practices on health, environment, and security at universal and societal dimensions and the problems that are reflected in the engineering field of the era.
